verdict.line: You lose if you facetank an active W (Indestructible) or get isolated in his R (Realm of Death) while behind; you win by silencing his shield with Q and closing with true-damage R.

brief.thesis: Neither champion has a dash, so the entire lane is decided by two cooldowns: your Q (Decisive Strike) silence and his W (Indestructible) shield-into-heal. If you silence him before he can trigger W, your all-in damage goes through clean; if he gets W off first, he out-sustains your spin and passive regen. His only way to stick to you or stop you leaving is E (Death's Grip), so tracking that cooldown tells you when trades are free.

theirWindow.when: his W and E are both up
theirWindow.what: Don't extend past mid-wave. He can shield through your damage with W, pull you off a wall or minion with E, and punish with Q plus autos while your silence is on cooldown.

yourWindow.when: his W (Indestructible) just went on cooldown
yourWindow.what: All-in immediately: Q (Decisive Strike) to silence and deny a reactivation window, then E (Judgment) and autos. Without the shield he cannot out-heal your damage, and if he's under roughly 30% you can close with R (Demacian Justice).

start.why: The passive damage block blunts his Q/passive poke and stacks with Perseverance regen so you win extended shoving trades before level 6.

boots.why: Tenacity shortens the lockdown from Death's Grip and the magic resist directly counters his fully magic-damage kit.

core.why: Early spellblade burst plus the slow lets you stick a full trade and land every auto before he can walk back into minions to reset the fight.
Armor pen plus built-in Grievous Wounds directly neutralizes the heal he gets from converting damage through W (Indestructible).
Bonus health, AD, and tenacity keep you alive through his level 6+ all-ins and shorten how long Death's Grip's pull disables you.

situational.when: he's building pure burst AP and out-trading your all-ins
the lane has snowballed and he's diving with jungler/mid support post-6
you need Grievous Wounds online before Serylda's Grudge finishes
he rushes a burst item and threatens to kill you before you can react

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained spin-and-auto trading style this matchup demands, converting stacks into healing that races his own W-fueled sustain over a long trade.

summoners.why: Flash is your only way to dodge or reposition around Death's Grip since neither champion has a dash. Teleport resets you after a lost trade or shoved wave and keeps you on track for your mid-game item spikes.

playing.title: Silence before he shields
playing.detail: Fire Q (Decisive Strike) the instant he starts channeling W (Indestructible) so it's on cooldown before triggering, denying the shield and heal for that exchange.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown
playing.detail: Death's Grip is his only gap tool in either direction. When it's down you can freely extend trades and walk away afterward since he has nothing to stick to you or escape with.

playing.title: Bait W before committing
playing.detail: Throw a low-value poke first to force his W (Indestructible) activation, then unload your real all-in once the shield is already spent.

playing.title: Respect level 6 duel forcing
playing.detail: Don't overextend below roughly 60% HP once he hits 6. R (Realm of Death) isolates you for a forced 1v1 that nobody can interfere in, though your own R still lands full true damage inside it.

playing.title: Hold R for the finish
playing.detail: Save Demacian Justice until he's committed or below roughly 30% HP; it scales off missing health so it closes duels rather than opening them.

playing.title: Freeze if you're ahead
playing.detail: Perseverance regen lets you hold a freeze near your tower better than he can punish, denying his farm and setting up jungle ganks.

playing.title: Rush anti-heal if he's out-sustaining you
playing.detail: If his W conversion is out-healing your damage, prioritize Serylda's Grudge earlier than planned or grab Executioner's Calling as a bridge item.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names drift patch to patch; this reflects the standard Garen bruiser build and Precision/Resolve page as of early 2026 training data, so confirm current names and stats in-client before locking runes.
